title: Funngro Teen Marketing Site (2 Pages) with SEO + Warm Teen Theme

requirements.summary: Implement a responsive, 2-page teen-focused marketing site with clear navigation between the two pages and consistent semantic section structure.
acceptanceCriteria: App has exactly two primary pages/routes accessible via top navigation and clear CTAs (e.g., header links/buttons).
Both pages are mobile-first and adapt cleanly to tablet/desktop (no overlapping content; spacing and typography scale appropriately).
Page structure uses semantic sections (header, main, section, footer) and consistent components (hero, benefits, steps, testimonials/quotes, FAQ, footer).

file_operations.description: Define exactly two primary routes for the marketing site (Teen Landing + Teen Details), wire top-level layout, and ensure navigation/CTAs link between the two pages (no additional primary pages).
Create a shared marketing layout that uses semantic markup (header/main/footer), wraps routed pages, and provides consistent spacing/section patterns across both pages.

Create a responsive top navigation with links to both pages and a prominent CTA button; compose shadcn-ui Button (and related primitives as needed). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a footer with internal links to both pages and key sections (e.g., How it works, FAQ) using accessible link text; keep consistent across both pages.
Create a reusable semantic <section> wrapper with optional heading/description slots to keep page structure consistent and improve readability/SEO.

requirements.summary: Create the Teen Landing page with SEO-friendly English copy: hero, benefits, how-it-works overview, trust signals, and repeated primary CTA with footer links.
acceptanceCriteria: Teen Landing page contains: a single H1, multiple scannable H2 sections, short paragraphs, and bullet lists where appropriate.
Copy is written in English and is SEO-oriented (includes relevant terms like “teen freelancing”, “paid projects for teens”, “earn money as a teen”, without keyword stuffing).
Primary CTA is visually prominent above the fold and repeated near the bottom of the page.
Footer includes internal links to the second page and core sections (e.g., How it works, FAQ).

file_operations.description: Implement Page 1 (Teen Landing) with a single H1, scannable H2 sections (benefits, how it works, trust signals, FAQ preview), warm teen-friendly marketing copy, and prominent CTA above-the-fold and near bottom; compose shadcn-ui Card/Badge/Button as appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a trust signals component (stats or short quotes) designed for the landing page; compose shadcn-ui Card and typography patterns. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a compact how-it-works overview (3–4 steps) suitable for the landing page, using semantic headings and bullet lists; compose shadcn-ui Card if needed. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire TeenLandingPage into the routing and ensure nav/CTA routes correctly to Teen Details; ensure footer links point to the second page and landing sections.

requirements.summary: Create the Teen Details page with expanded SEO-friendly English content: detailed steps, eligibility, safety/trust explanation, FAQs, and a secondary CTA with internal linking.
acceptanceCriteria: Teen Details page contains: a single H1 distinct from Page 1, logical H2/H3 hierarchy, and an FAQ section with question headings and concise answers.
Includes internal links back to the Teen Landing page and to key sections within the page (anchor links if used).
Content is clearly targeted to teen intent (what you do, how you get projects, how payments/verification works at a high level, safety).

file_operations.description: Implement Page 2 (Teen Details) with a distinct single H1, H2/H3 hierarchy for steps/eligibility/safety, an FAQ section, internal links back to Teen Landing, optional on-page anchor navigation, and a secondary CTA; compose shadcn-ui Accordion for FAQs and Button for CTAs. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an FAQ accordion component with accessible headings and concise answers, intended for the Teen Details page; compose shadcn-ui Accordion primitives. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create an eligibility/requirements block (bullet lists + short explanations) for the Teen Details page, keeping content teen-focused and scannable.
Wire TeenDetailsPage into the routing and ensure top navigation and CTAs allow moving between both pages.

requirements.summary: Add SEO-ready metadata for both pages with centralized per-route configuration: unique titles, meta descriptions, robots policy, and canonical URL strategy (configurable).
acceptanceCriteria: Each page sets a unique document title and meta description (no duplicates).
Pages have exactly one H1 each, descriptive H2s, and meaningful link text (no “click here”).
All images used in-page have descriptive alt text.
Site includes a basic robots meta policy (index/follow) and is ready to add canonical URLs without code refactor (e.g., centralized metadata config per route).

file_operations.description: Create a centralized metadata map for the two routes (title, description, robots index/follow, canonical path), with a configurable canonical base URL (e.g., via Vite environment variable) to avoid refactors later.
Implement a small hook that applies per-route SEO metadata at runtime (document title, meta description, robots meta, canonical link tag) based on the centralized routeMetadata config.
Use the SEO hook to set unique title/description/robots/canonical for Teen Landing and ensure semantic headings (exactly one H1) and meaningful internal link text.
Use the SEO hook to set unique title/description/robots/canonical for Teen Details and ensure semantic headings (exactly one H1) and meaningful internal link text.
Ensure the base HTML is SEO-ready (language already set) and include any minimal defaults that do not conflict with per-route runtime metadata (avoid duplicating per-page titles/descriptions).

requirements.summary: Apply a coherent, warm teen-focused visual theme (non-blue/purple-forward) with consistent typography, spacing, components, and accessible interaction states across both pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Both pages share a consistent design system (same button variants, typography scale, card styles, spacing rhythm).
Theme uses a distinct non-blue/purple-forward palette and looks intentional across headers, CTAs, and section backgrounds.
Interactive elements have clear hover/focus states and meet basic accessibility expectations (visible focus, readable contrast).

file_operations.description: Adjust global theme tokens (CSS variables used by Tailwind/shadcn-ui) to a warm, teen-appropriate palette (avoid blue/purple dominance), define consistent typography/spacing defaults, and ensure visible focus styles.
Extend/adjust Tailwind theme (if needed) to support the warm marketing palette, gradients/backgrounds, and consistent section spacing utilities without introducing new global stylesheet entry points.

Apply consistent layout patterns (section padding, max widths, background alternation) and shared button styles via shadcn-ui Button variants. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add required generated static marketing images under public assets and render them responsively on both pages with descriptive alt text.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend.
Images appear in the hero and/or section headers in a way that supports the overall layout without breaking responsiveness.
All rendered images include alt text aligned to what is visually depicted (not keyword stuffing).

file_operations.description: Add the generated Teen-focused hero illustration asset to the public generated assets folder for direct frontend use.
Add the generated 6-icon set asset (projects, earnings, skills, safety, time flexibility, mentorship) to the public generated assets folder for direct frontend use.
Add the generated warm abstract background texture/shape gradient asset (non-blue/purple dominant) to the public generated assets folder for direct frontend use.

Render frontend/public/assets/generated/funngro-teen-hero.dim_1600x900.png in the hero (responsive) and use frontend/public/assets/generated/funngro-teen-icons.dim_512x512.png for benefits/feature visuals; ensure descriptive, non-keyword-stuffed alt text.

Use frontend/public/assets/generated/funngro-warm-bg.dim_1920x1080.png as a decorative background for a section header area and reuse frontend/public/assets/generated/funngro-teen-icons.dim_512x512.png where helpful; ensure responsive rendering and accurate alt text for any non-decorative images.
